Class HeadlessSession

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.client.Trainer
dev.swordai.client.ReplicaTrainer
dev.swordai.client.HeadlessSession
All Implemented Interfaces:
AgentSession, ArenaDriver
public final class HeadlessSession extends ReplicaTrainer implements ArenaDriver
Training without the screen. The agent's body is a fake player, run as if it had a game client of its own (ReplicaBody): the same body the network is given when a person spars against it. Its picture is drawn rather than read off the screen, so nothing has to be rendered for it and the world can run as fast as the computer manages. What is trained, and how, is Trainer's and exactly the same as on the screen.

Everything about the training runs on the server thread, called from the arena's tick. The client thread only asks: for the status, and for a stop, which it hands over. The user's own character is not touched and stays theirs to play.
